summary: Loma Negra filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release for the period ended September 30, 2026. Net sales were Ps. 270,107 million (US$177 million), down 3.2% year-over-year, and consolidated Adjusted EBITDA was Ps. 54,189 million (US$42 million), a 20.1% margin down 74 basis points. Net profit reached Ps. 14,482 million versus a prior-year loss, and net debt fell to Ps. 220,486 million, or 1.00x LTM Adjusted EBITDA. A US$150 million bond was issued post-quarter to refinance structured maturities. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
